title: Disable Default Panel Opening
description: elements/ui/UI: Make sure no panel is opened by default, including compose/algorithms and compose/sketchpad details panels. Extend existing tests only and verify relevant checks pass.
summary: Updated shared UI and sketchpad defaults so side/detail panels start closed by default, including mobile panel state in elements UI and app/default/fallback panel visibility in sketchpad. Extended existing embedded tests to assert default closed panel visibility. Verified with focused sketchpad Playwright test, sketchpad production build, and runtime browser check against a local dev server. UI package test command currently reports no test files; UI lint is blocked by pre-existing Storybook renderer import rule violations in .storybook/stories.
